lines: An amount recorded on this matter's file: a fee charged, an hourly rate billed, a disbursement, an invoice and its dates, a payment, trust money, a costs estimate issued to the client, time recorded: user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter (then user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/ask); the practice system is the system of record for these

What the firm's own policy, procedure, fee schedule or a practice direction requires or sets: who must approve, sign or review, which bank or account, a threshold or limit, a standard charge or rate, a deadline or turnaround time, a required document or step: user_firm_policies_and_practice_directions; the policy index holds the firm's policies and the practice direction

Relationships between people and organisations in the matter: who represents whom, employer, children, who prepared a document, which judge heard an event: user_case_knowledge_graph/entity (then user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher); the entity dossier lists a person's relationships with their documents; cypher counts and filters

A single personal property of a named person, such as date of birth or residential address: user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher (then user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter); Cypher answered both personal-detail probes, agreeing with Matter AI ask and with the practice system's contact record on address. The practice system holds current contact addresses but returned nothing for date of birth

Several facts about one party at once (address, business, representation): user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher (then user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter); Cypher, Matter AI ask and the practice system all answered the combined party-details probe. The entity variant answered 0 of 6 multi-fact probes.

A figure a matter document states about the parties' finances: a superannuation balance, the asset pool, a valuation, an income or a loan balance: user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/ask (then user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher); documents state these as at their own date

Whether the matter documents record a given event, allegation or position (for example family violence, a lawyer's stance, a bankruptcy): user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/ask (then user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher); Matter AI ask answered 3 of 3 such probes, including saying when no document supports a claim. Cypher answered 2 and agreed with ask, while search snippets conflicted.

Exact wording quoted from a matter document (certificates, draft orders, letters): user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/search (then user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/ask); the passage itself is the answer

Summaries of what the matter or a matter document says (overall dispute, a report's view, orders made): user_matter_ai_okafor_and_nguyen_matter/ask (then user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher); Ask answered 3 of 3 matter-summary probes and agreed with cypher on all three. The knowledge-graph entity variant conflicted on two, and search snippets conflicted on two.

The court's listing for a named court file number: its listed dates and times, courtroom, status or judicial officer: user_court_list_and_company_register (then user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter)
Company register particulars for a named company or ACN: incorporation date, registered office, officers, former names or share structure: user_court_list_and_company_register

The organisation, address or role recorded for a contact on the matter, such as an expert, a valuer or a practitioner: user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter (then user_case_knowledge_graph/cypher)
Itemised billing: the line items of an invoice and what each charged: user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter
A court diary event as the firm recorded it: the date, time or courtroom of the next or final hearing: user_practice_management_system_okafor_matter (then user_court_list_and_company_register)
